chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washa, from Al-Rida (peace be upon him), said:
I asked him about the Ziyarah of the grave of Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) being like the grave of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him)? He said: Yes.
ai.seo_question: Is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam Musa Al-Kazim equal to visiting Imam Al-Husayn?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Musa al-Kazim (as) confirms that the spiritual merit of visiting his own grave is equivalent to that of Imam al-Husayn (as), highlighting the unique status of the Imams as intercessors and sources of divine grace. This equivalence underscores the Shia theological view that the graves of the Ahl al-Bayt serve as focal points for *tawassul* and spiritual connection, mirroring the profound significance of Karbala. The brevity of the report emphasizes the certainty (*yaqeen*) of this reward without needing extensive elaboration, reflecting the direct authority of the Imam in defining ritual merit.
